title: Phenomenal content is real and supervenes locally on the brain

statements.text: Mental content has two kinds: intentional content and the locally supervening phenomenal content of a representation. The phenomenal content of bodily self-representation is entirely determined by internal properties of the brain, so a brain in a vat could have the experience of holding a paper in its hands.

sources.quote: The phenomenal content of your bodily self-representation is entirely determined by internal properties of your brain.
Consciousness not only locally supervenes, in the target domain it locally supervenes on parts of single organisms.
